build_rpn_head: build an RPN head module from config to predict objectness logits and anchor deltas for feature maps
create_standard_rpn_head: create a StandardRPNHead with configurable conv layers to classify anchors and regress bounding box deltas
build_rpn: build a Region Proposal Network from config with anchor generator, matcher, and head for Faster R-CNN
label_and_sample_anchors: label and sample anchors by matching them with ground truth boxes using IoU and subsampling
compute_rpn_losses: compute RPN classification and localization losses from predicted objectness logits and anchor deltas
